name: Town of Eastchester (unincorporated)
gaps: Eastchester's Zoning Law isn't on eCode360; used the Town's own PDFs: Zoning Law as amended 5-26-2026 and the Schedules of District Regulations dated 03-19-13 (page says they're current for the law as amended 03-05-21). No later schedule amendment found in the 2026 text.
County code 'M1' = M 1000; Zoning Law § 4.A lists 'M 1000 (M1)'.
Principal-building height 23 ft is measured to the eave of a sloped roof; ridge limit (33 ft) is stored as max_ridge_height_ft for R-20 to R5 only; R3/M districts have no ridge column.
GFA (§ 9.Q) only lists R-20 to R-1.5C and R-3; none for M districts/RTD. GFA for lots below the district minimum isn't addressed (table value used).

Wetlands, steep-slope and tree rules: § 9.E refers to a Town 'Freshwater Wetlands Protection Law', but the Town Code chapters (wetlands, trees, steep slopes) weren't found online, so buffers are null.
min_lot_width/depth not set; schedule uses frontage plus an 'effective square' (noted).

wetlands.summary: Zoning Law § 9.E cites a Town Freshwater Wetlands Protection Law; text not found online, buffer unknown. NYS DEC 100 ft adjacent area applies to state wetlands.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep-slope rule found in the Zoning Law; site plans need 1-ft contours.

trees.summary: No tree-removal permit found in the Zoning Law; site plans must show trees over 4 in. caliper (§ 11.F.3).

stormwater.summary: § 11.F.5(i) (L.L. 1-2026): zero increase in peak runoff through the 100-year storm; new houses or >50% impervious increase must compare against an unimproved lot.

adu.summary: No accessory-apartment provision in the Zoning Law; accessory buildings can't be used as dwellings (§ 9.K); up to 2 boarders allowed in one-family homes.

general.accessory_structures: Detached accessory buildings follow the schedule's distances from house, side and rear lines, are barred from any front yard, and are limited to 12 ft (15 ft to ridge). Sheds up to 8x10 need no permit; one shed per lot, max 10x12 (§ 7.B.6).
general.pools: Rear yard only, at least 10 ft from side and rear lot lines; 4 ft fence; surrounding decks/patios meet building yards (§ 9.S).
general.notes: Every new one- or two-family house, and front additions over 30% of the front elevation, get Planning Board site plan and ARB review (§ 11.E.2). Projections: covered porches/eaves 4 ft into front yard; open decks 6 ft into rear and 4 ft into side yards (min 6 ft to line) (§ 7.D).

R-20.name: One Family Residence R 20

max_building_coverage.note: Principal building; accessory buildings may cover another 4% (26% total). Coverage counts all roofed areas incl. covered porches

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious surface coverage, § 9.P table; applies to every lot with a one- or two-family dwelling in any district

max_floor_area.note: § 9.Q: table value plus 10% of lot area above the district minimum; excludes non-story basements, half-story attics and up to 400 sf of a one-story garage; spaces 15 ft+ high count double; land under water excluded. Code gives no reduction for undersized lots.

accessory.notes: Detached accessory buildings: 18 ft from the house, 15 ft from side and 15 ft from rear lot lines; not in any front yard; 12 ft height (eave/flat roof), 15 ft to ridge; play structures 12 ft max. Attached accessory buildings follow principal-building rules (§ 7.D.3)

R-20.notes: Effective square 120 ft per side required for new subdivision lots (§ 9.O). Height 23 ft / 2.5 stories is the lesser limit, measured to the eave of a sloped roof or top of a flat roof; max ridge height 33 ft; min height 1.5 stories / 15 ft. First floor max 3 ft above front grade. 'First side' and 'second side' yards are set separately in the schedule.
